request: Track my livestock: for each goat give tag number, breed, birth date, weight in kg each month, vaccination dates, and deworming dates. Warn me 7 days before any vaccine is due and show a monthly weight chart per goat.
ref:
app "Goats" paw mint
table goat tag text, breed text, born date
table weight goat ref goat, kg num 0..200 unit "kg"
table vaccine goat ref goat, name text, due date
table deworm goat ref goat
"Vaccines due in 7 days" count(vaccine, it.due - today <= 7 and it.due >= today) big color if(count(vaccine, it.due - today <= 7 and it.due >= today) > 0, warn, ink)
each vaccine where due - today <= 7 and due >= today sort due
  row card
    it.goat.tag it.name grow
    it.due bold color warn
remind "Vaccine due" at vaccine.due
each goat as g
  stack card gap 1
    g.tag g.breed head
    "Born" g.born "| Last dewormed" last(g.deworm.at) faint
    "Weight by month" faint
    trend g.weight, it.kg
    button "Dewormed today" tap add deworm goat = g
form goat, "Add goat"
form weight, "Log weight"
form vaccine, "Add vaccine"
output:
app "Livestock" paw mint
table goat tag text, kind pick Goat|Dog|Bird|Rabbit|Other = Goat, born date, weight num 0.., vaccinated bool
table treat goat ref goat
remind "A goat vaccine is due" at treat.born
each goat sort name as g
  stack card gap 1 tap edit g swipe remove g
    row gap 1
      g.tag bold grow
      g.kind faint
      "Brened" g.born faint
    "Vaccine" g.vaccinated faint
form goat, "Add goat"
form treat, "Add treatment"

request: A weekly timetable grid with colours per subject; tap a box to change the class in it
ref:
app "Timetable" school ocean
table cell day pick Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri, period num 1..8, subject pick Maths|English|Science|Urdu|Islamiat|Free = Free
grid 5 gap 1
  each options cell.day as dd
    stack gap 1
      dd bold align center
      each 1..8 as p
        if count(cell where day = dd and period = p) = 0
          box height 40 radius 6 fill soft tap add cell day = dd, period = p
            p tiny color muted align center
        each cell where day = dd and period = p as c
          box height 40 radius 6 fill if(c.subject = Maths, accent, if(c.subject = English, good, if(c.subject = Science, warn, if(c.subject = Urdu, bad, if(c.subject = Islamiat, ink, soft))))) tap edit c
            c.subject tiny bold align center color bg
output:
app "Timetable" school plum
table slot subject pick Maths|English|Science|History|Art, start time, place text?
state m date = today
monthnav m
grid 7 gap 1
  each ["M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S", "S"] as w
    w tiny color muted align center
  each 1..weekday(m - monthday(m) + 1) - 1
    box
  each days month of m as d
    box height 36 radius 6 fill if(count(slot on d) = 0, soft, if(count(slot on d where subject = m and start = d) > 0, good, if(count(slot on d where subject = m and start = d) = 0, warn, bad)))
      monthday(d) small align center
"Today" count(slot today) "of" count(slot week) "packed" faint
